Genuine vs Compatible Printer Ribbons

We stock both genuine and compatible printer ribbons. Genuine printer ribbons are manufactured by the original brand (HP, Canon, Epson, Brother) and come with the manufacturer's warranty. Compatible printer ribbons are alternatives engineered to comparable results. Learn more about genuine vs compatible cartridges.

How to Choose the Right Ribbon

Find the ribbon code

Search the make and model of your typewriter or printer, or the code printed on your current ribbon spool or cassette. Each ribbon lists the machines it fits.

Typewriter or printer ribbon

Typewriter ribbons fit typewriters. Printer ribbons fit dot-matrix, impact and receipt printers. Check which kind your machine takes before you order.

Correction tape

Many electronic typewriters also take a correction tape, which is sold separately from the ribbon.

Frequently asked questions

How do I find the right ribbon for my typewriter?

Check the make and model on your typewriter and search for it, or search the code printed on your current ribbon spool. Unopened items can be returned within 30 days.

Do you ship printer ribbons across all of New Zealand?

Yes. Auckland metro orders placed before 12:00 NZT on a business day are dispatched the same day. North Island 1-3 business days; South Island 1-3 business days. Free NZ shipping on qualifying orders.

How many printer ribbons do you stock?

We list 109 printer ribbons — 11 genuine and 98 compatible from leading NZ brands.

Are the prices for Printer Ribbons GST-inclusive?

Yes, every price on InkCartridges.co.nz includes 15% New Zealand GST.
